rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
compound with internal sandhi: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ + mūlakaulam

items.question: What eightfold attainment is identified as rooted in the Mūlakaula?
premises: A set of eight is being enumerated.
This set concerns the attainment of powers.
The attainment of powers is rooted in the Mūlakaula.
items.inference: The eightfold attainment of powers belongs to or is grounded in the Mūlakaula.
uncertainties: The exact internal analysis of the compound siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ is somewhat ambiguous without further context.
items.plain_english: And, O fair-faced one, there are eight attainments of powers rooted in the Mūlakaula.
